title: Prime Detector
statementMd:
Decide whether **n** is prime (it has exactly two divisors: 1 and itself). Print `Prime` or `Not prime`.

**Input**
One integer `n` (1 ≤ n ≤ 10⁹).

**Output**
`Prime` or `Not prime`.

n can be large — you only need to test divisors up to √n.
hints: 1 is not prime. Every other n is prime unless some d between 2 and n−1 divides it.
If n has a divisor, it has one ≤ √n — loop while d * d <= n (use long for d * d).
